metric: PTY graphics output frames and changed source crop; native compositor excluded

startup.scope: 3 alternating warm pairs, first complete placement, OS caches not cleared

verification.signature: ad hoc signed and codesign --verify --strict passed
verification.pixel_comparison: 40 actual CLI viewports, before/after RGBA and placement geometry identical; README and TECH, light/dark, top/middle/bottom, cache boundary, reversal, jump and resize
verification.reload: changed source exactly matches reference and differs from old content
verification.review: independent reviewer and CodeRabbit; fixed pending GPU deletion on batched reload/quit and quiet continuation chunks

limitations: End timestamp is complete protocol output received by a PTY, not native display presentation.
SGR wheel events validate terminal input protocol; physical trackpad acceleration/inertia and native Ghostty appearance were not tested because computer-use app access was denied.
Both versions already emit about60 output frames/s during60Hz input. Improvement is fractional position changes, reduced input latency and image retransmission; native compositor FPS is unknown.
Maximum observed frame gap was27.85ms before and28.20ms after. There are occasional preparation-transfer gaps; this is not a no-dropped-frame guarantee.
Startup median in3 alternating pairs was265.95ms before and278.24ms after; first image remains viewport-only with asynchronous wider preparation.
macOS arm64 release tested locally; no remote CI, commit, push, merge or deployment.

comparison.sustained_input: 120 j inputs at60Hz over2 seconds per run plus settling
